links.rationale: C025 is the scoped successor residual after C024: it restores simultaneous integral correlation on normalized G_NEQ but shows that the repaired first-order state still lacks super-logarithmic cardinality capacity.
Both reject a representation as route-sufficient after a cheap extremal/capacity audit, but C025 concerns first-order joint states rather than a scalar statistic.

reusable_method_lesson_candidate.observation: A representation repair can exactly remove the parent failure on its benchmark yet remain route-insufficient because the repaired representation has a separately provable capacity ceiling.
reusable_method_lesson_candidate.candidate_framework_delta: After a candidate claims to restore a missing structural coordinate, require two separate gates: old-failure regression and a capacity/expressivity audit of the repaired representation before target-first promotion.
